reader.requirement: At --std 85 LINE-COUNTER may appear in the Report Section only in a SOURCE clause, in the Procedure Division in any sending context where an integral data item may (condition, arithmetic, subscript, reference-modification position, PERFORM TIMES), and never as a receiving operand of any statement (only the RWCS changes it); the witnesses cover SOURCE and one MOVE refusal.

reader.notes: Every receiving slot funnels through ExpressionBinder's receiving chokepoint, whose first form arm refuses LINE-COUNTER by token; CALL BY REFERENCE is routed through the same refusal by MeetsByReferenceRules. In the Report Section every non-SOURCE operand path (SUM addend, CONTROL, RESET ON, CODE) refuses it. DISPLAY LINE-COUNTER prints 10 digits (implementor size), not judged here.

refuter.evidence: I probed the receiving slots the reader did not try, each at --std 85 with --compile-only, and every one was refused with COBOL2197: INSPECT TALLYING LINE-COUNTER (LX1); STRING ... WITH POINTER LINE-COUNTER (LX2); UNSTRING WITH POINTER (LX3), TALLYING IN (LX4) and COUNT IN (LX5); SET LINE-COUNTER TO 3 (LX6); MULTIPLY GIVING (LX7); PERFORM ... AFTER LINE-COUNTER (LX8; also COBOL0900 for the 2002 inline AFTER); INSPECT REPLACING (LX9) and CONVERTING (LXE); MOVE TO LINE-COUNTER IN RPT (LXA); SUBTRACT GIVING (LXB); DIVIDE REMAINDER (LXC); ACCEPT FROM DAY (LXD); SEARCH ... VARYING LINE-COUNTER (LY3). Sending uses are accepted with correct values in LY1: SOURCE LINE-COUNTER; MOVE to WS-E (LINE-COUNTER) after two GENERATEs puts Z at position 2; SET IX TO LINE-COUNTER followed by UP BY LINE-COUNTER gives 04; EVALUATE prints EV2; GO TO P2 P3 DEPENDING ON LINE-COUNTER goes to P3. Outside both licensed places, OCCURS DEPENDING ON LINE-COUNTER in Working-Storage is refused (LY2, COBOL2024). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.6 SR2  (3.5.6 LINE-COUNTER Rules)  the text is in SR2'.
